## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and is at most 100 characters.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `lefthook run pre-push` passes locally.
- [ ] Public API and behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, pairing material, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` and explained with a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
